title: Cartwise Grocery Orders Training Note: The Price-Protection Guarantee and the Membership Ledger
content:
# Price-protection guarantee and the Cartwise+ membership ledger

Training note for the Cartwise Grocery Orders refund desk, in question-and-answer form.

## The rule

The price-protection guarantee multiplies the price-protection excess on a replacement line before the refund is rounded to the cent. When the customer's membership ledger shows at least 3 period fees charged within the last 36 whole calendar months, the excess is returned twice over (multiplied by 2). When it shows 1 or 2 such fees, the excess is returned one and a half times (multiplied by 1.5). A ledger showing no such fee does not alter the excess.

Months are counted by anniversary: between an earlier date and a later date as many whole months have passed as there are monthly anniversaries of the earlier date falling on or before the later date, so a period fee counts as charged within the last 36 whole calendar months when fewer than 36 such months have passed from its charge date to today, and a fee charged earlier in the current month is 0 months old.

## Questions answered

**Whose ledger is read?** The customer's own Cartwise+ Membership ledger, counting its period fee charges.

**Does the plan's billing cycle matter?** No. The rule counts period fees charged in the window, monthly or annual alike.

**How many fees give the double return?** 3 or more within the window. With exactly 2, or exactly 1, the excess is returned one and a half times.

**Does a fee charged 36 months ago still count?** Only while fewer than 36 whole months have passed since its charge date. A fee charged on 10 May counts on 9 May three years later (35 whole months) and no longer counts on 10 May three years later (36 whole months).

**When is the multiple applied?** To the excess itself, before the refund is rounded to the cent once.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)

| Period fees in the last 36 whole months | Multiple | Excess of 0.60 becomes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 5 | 2 | 1.20 |
| 3 | 2 | 1.20 |
| 2 | 1.5 | 0.90 |
| 1 | 1.5 | 0.90 |
| 0 | excess not altered | 0.60 |
